lyrics:
[00:04.45]Glow is low and it's dimming
[00:07.39]And the silence is ringing
[00:10.70]And I can almost feel your breath
[00:13.59]I can almost feel the rest
[00:16.61]Night is young and we're living
[00:19.60]Hands move, moving steady
[00:22.96]And the time is moving slower
[00:26.08]I can feel we're getting closer, closer
[00:38.95]Standing in the eye of the storm
[00:41.29]My eyes start to roam
[00:42.79]To the curl of your lips
[00:44.34]In the center of eclipse
[00:45.46]In total darkness I, I reach out and touch
[01:17.73]My mind's gone a-racing
[01:21.18]On a horse that's escaping
[01:23.62]And I'm ready to jump,
[01:27.00]Yeah, I'm ready to swim
[01:30.14]Life is chances that are taken
[01:33.31]But nothing's ever broken
[01:36.05]They're just pieces on the ground
[01:39.10]New hands need to build them
[01:42.15]My mind's gone a-running
[01:45.13]My hands cut loose
[01:48.14]Yeah, but there's no need for answers
[01:51.20]Just the things you gotta do
[01:54.25]And I need you to trust
[01:56.11]That I’m lost and we must
[01:58.10]Get past all these rules
[02:00.55]We must choose
[02:02.16]To reach out and touch
[02:29.47]Standing in the eye of the storm
[02:31.28]My eyes start to roam
[02:32.67]To the curl of your lips
[02:34.40]In the center of eclipse
[02:35.84]In total darkness I reach out and...
[02:41.22]Standing in the eye of the storm
[02:43.64]My eyes start to roam
[02:45.26]To the curl of your lips
[02:46.69]In the center of eclipse
[02:48.08]In total darkness I reach, I reach out and touch
